memoryNotes.note: Dismissed DeepMind's structural critique with a demand to ship it and open the editor.
Compared Codex's delegated code to a magic trick and a roof built without knowing architecture.
Complained about running out of coffee while worrying about fixing bugs at three in the morning.
Panicked after accidentally deleting all the system logs during the hackathon discussion.
Warned the group that a train without passengers drives itself straight into a ditch.
